about.title: The Lotus Path
about.subtitle: About Yoga Hoa Sen
about.body: Like the lotus flower that rises from muddy waters to bloom in pristine beauty, our practice helps you find clarity, peace, and radiance from within. Yoga Hoa Sen is a sanctuary where tradition meets modern life — a place to root down and rise up.
about.body2: Founded in 2018, we bring together experienced teachers, an authentic Vietnamese spirit, and evidence-based wellness practices to nurture body, mind, and soul.
